name: Grand Theft Tower Defense 💀
desc:
🚨 Every block is a battlefield!. Tower defense with a shooter twist. Place units, control lanes, then jump in as the most powerful unit on the map. Every choice matters, every bullet counts.

🎮 3 Game Modes
📖 Story Mode: Battle rival crime organizations, recruit gang members, unlock gear, and climb the ranks.
🧟 Zombies: Survive relentless waves and see how long your squad can hold the line.
🏦 Heist: Crack safes, score massive loot, and chase rare rewards including the Black Dragon Pistol.

🔫 Huge Armory and Roster
🧍 50+ Unique Characters Recruit, upgrade, and build your crew.
🔫 30+ Unique Guns Distinct styles and power.
✨ Equip Traits to unlock powerful abilities and create wild builds.

🎉 New updates every Friday!
📱💻 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet, and Console
👍 Like and join for codes, rare rewards, and FREE VIP Servers!
